data.long_meaning: Nazia is an Arabic name that signifies pride, glory, and honor. It is a popular name in many Muslim cultures, symbolizing a strong and confident individual. The name Nazia carries the meaning “Pride, glory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazia usually hope their child will grow to embody pride, glory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nazia is associated with the concept of 'izzah, which refers to the honor and dignity bestowed upon believers by Allah.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazia total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: نازية

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم نازية مشتق من الفعل نَزَعَ، ويعني الاسم الجمال والرقة والدلال، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة النازعات، وتُعَدّ هذه التسمية من الأسماء الجميلة والمحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث تعبر عن الأنوثة والجمال الداخلي.

in_urdu.name: نازیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نازیہ نام کا مطلب خوبصورتی، ناز، اور دل کی خوشی سے ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور انوثة کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ یہ نام خوبصورت اور دلکش معنوں کی بنا پر پسند کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नाज़िया
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाज़िया नाम का अर्थ सुंदरता, नाज़, और मन की खुशी से है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इस्लामी संस्कृति में सुंदरता और स्त्रीत्व की प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम अपनी सुंदर और आकर्षक अर्थों के कारण पसंद किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نازيه

in_pashto.long_meaning: نازيه نوم د ښايسته والی، ناز، او د زړه خوښۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو نومونو کې ځای لري. دا نوم د ښځینه نومونو په منځ کې د هغې د ښکلي او مثبت مفهوم له امله مشهور دی.

in_english.name: Nazia
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nazia originates from the Arabic root 'n-z-‘’ which means to pull out or to extract. It signifies beauty, delicacy, and charm. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the term 'Naziat' (النازعات) in Surah 79 refers to angels extracting souls gently. The name Nazia symbolizes feminine beauty, grace, and inner elegance, making it a popular choice across various Muslim cultures for its positive connotations and aesthetic appeal.

It is derived from the Arabic root "anaza," which means "to shine," "to be proud," or "to be exalted." In Islamic beliefs, the human soul is believed to be a divine spark that shines with the light of God. Thus, the name Nazia can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual pride and honor that comes from being a beloved creation of God. It is a name that encourages one to strive for excellence and to live a life that is pleasing to God. By embracing the spiritual significance of the name Nazia, one can cultivate a strong sense of self-worth, confidence, and humility, and live a life that reflects the glory and honor of God.
